subject.title: Feature Request: Add premium request % to /usage footer

question: Should enabled per-response `/usage` footers automatically show active-provider quota windows, and if so must the quota snapshot be prepared or lifecycle-cached outside reply finalization?
rationale: The user value is clear and current generic seams can format the data, but all direct implementations closed unmerged and a reply-time provider fetch changes latency, network cadence, and hot-path ownership; repository evidence cannot choose that product tradeoff.

options.title: Approve prepared quota footer
options.body: Add generic quota-window text using provider data prepared or lifecycle-cached before footer rendering, with omit-on-failure behavior.

options.title: Keep quota in status
options.body: Retain `/status` as the explicit provider-quota surface and close this feature as intentionally out of scope.

recommendation.title: Approve prepared quota footer
recommendation.body: Add generic quota-window text using provider data prepared or lifecycle-cached before footer rendering, with omit-on-failure behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal covers provider-usage loading, quota formatting, Copilot usage, status presentation, and the prior issue assessment.
